description: This file defines the API for the IARM bus Daemon, including enums, structs, and function prototypes for resource management, power states, resolution changes, and system modes within the IARM bus system.

methods.name: IARM_BusDaemon_RequestOwnership
methods.description: Requests ownership of a specified resource from the IARM Daemon.

methods.name: IARM_BusDaemon_ReleaseOwnership
methods.description: Releases ownership of a specified resource.

methods.name: IARM_BusDaemon_PowerPrechange
methods.description: Notifies the daemon of a pending power state change.

methods.name: IARM_BusDaemon_ResolutionPrechange
methods.description: Notifies the daemon of a pending resolution change.

methods.name: IARM_BusDaemon_ResolutionPostchange
methods.description: Notifies the daemon that a resolution change has occurred.

methods.name: IARM_BusDaemon_DeepSleepWakeup
methods.description: Signals the daemon to wake up from deep sleep.
